unlocks.title: The Bird Who Wood Be King
A Plesioth in the Misty Peaks
Sky Tribe: Rice to the Occasion

random.desc:
Increased Health recovery from
items, and Antidote Herb and
Bitterbug always work.
random.brief: Healing items restore 10% more Health (Potion 30 to 33), and an Antidote Herb or Bitterbug always cures poison. Stacks with Recovery Up.

random.desc:
Slows down Stamina depletion
when evading, blocking, etc.
random.brief: Rolls and other one-off moves cost 25% less Stamina, like one extra step of Constitution (half cost is the limit).

random.desc:
Increases damage for all types of
Barrel Bombs, and increases the
power of Blast attacks.
random.brief: Barrel Bomb L explodes like a Barrel Bomb L+ and Bounce Bomb like a Bounce Bomb+, and blast buildup is x1.1 (held to x1.25 total with Bombardier).

random.desc:
Increases the potency of
abnormal status attacks.
random.brief: Poison, paralysis and sleep build up x1.125 plus a small fixed bonus, on weapons, shots, coatings and thrown items. Shares a x1.25 limit with Status Atk.

random.desc: Often decreases damage taken.
random.brief: Each hit has a 25% chance to deal only 70% of its damage. With Divine Blessing it gets a second try, about 44% in total.

random.desc: Sometimes decreases damage taken.
random.brief: Each hit has a 12.5% (1 in 8) chance to deal only 70% of its damage. With Felyne Defender (Hi) in the meal only Hi counts.

random.desc:
Decreases the likelihood of
Horn/Flute items breaking.
random.brief: A 1 in 4 chance to save a flute that was about to break, so flutes break a quarter less often. Stacks with the Whim skills and Horn Maestro.

random.desc:
Decreases the likelihood of
Pickaxes and Bug Nets breaking.
random.brief: A 1 in 4 chance to save a pickaxe or bug net that was about to break, so they break a quarter less often. Boomerangs aren't affected.

random.desc:
Maximizes the number of times
you can talk to the Veggie Elder.
random.brief: The Veggie Elder always lets you trade 6 times in a row; normally only the first 2 trades are certain.

random.desc:
Increases Combination
success rate by 20%.
random.brief: +20% combination success, added on top of the Combination skills and Felyne Combiner (Lo). The rate can't go over 100%.

random.desc:
Increases Combination
success rate by 10%.
random.brief: +10% combination success, added on top of the Combination skills and Felyne Combiner (Hi). The rate can't go over 100%.

random.desc:
Sometimes increases the number
of times items can be gathered
at Gathering Points.
random.brief: Once a point's guaranteed gathers are used, each gather has a 12.5% chance of being its last instead of 21.9%. Stacks with the Gathering skills.

random.desc:
Increases the power of
Normal shots (Normal S).
random.brief: Normal S Lv1-3 and the Light Bowgun's charged shots deal x1.1 damage; nothing for Bow arrows. Stacks fully with Normal/Rapid Up for x1.21.

random.desc:
Greatly increases Attack when
Health is very low.
random.brief: Attack x1.35 while your Health is 10 or less (a fixed 10, not a percentage). With Adrenaline +2 it replaces the x1.3 rather than adding to it.

random.desc:
Helps your weapon retain
Sharpness when attacks
are deflected.
random.brief: When one of your hits bounces, you lose 1 Sharpness instead of 2. It does not stack with Razor Sharp.

random.desc:
Decreases Stamina depletion when
fleeing from large monsters.
random.brief: Sprinting drains Stamina half as fast (about 5 per second instead of 10) on any sprint, not only when fleeing large monsters.

random.desc:
Increases damage of projectiles
such as Stones, Throwing Knives,
and Boomerangs.
random.brief: Stones, throwing knives (not the Tranq Knife) and Boomerangs deal x2 damage, and stones, knives, paintballs and some bombs fly 1.5x faster. Dung Bomb combinations always succeed.

random.desc:
Prevents flinching when
discovered by a monster.
random.brief: You never do the startled flinch when a monster first spots you.

random.desc:
Slows Stamina depletion from
dashing and prevents knockbacks
when transporting an item.
random.brief: Running while carrying a transport item drains Stamina half as fast, and hits don't knock you back while you carry one. It doesn't slow the normal sprint.

random.desc:
Prevents being knocked back
when transporting an item.
random.brief: Hits no longer knock you back while you carry a transport item. Adds nothing alongside Felyne Supercat.

random.desc:
Large monsters encountered on
Quests have an increased chance
of being weaker than normal.
random.brief: Large monsters can no longer roll tougher than the quest's base health and attack; they come out at base or weaker. Online, anyone in the party having it counts.

random.desc:
Makes it easier to escape when
pinned down by a large monster.
random.brief: Breaking free of a large monster's pin takes about half the presses (2 count where 4 were needed). Works for Prowlers too.

random.desc:
Prevents you from sleeping
during a Quest, even on the
base camp bed.
random.brief: Monster attacks can't put you to sleep, like Negate Sleep, but you can't use the base camp bed.

random.desc:
Prevents you from getting
knocked on your butt.
random.brief: Attacks that would knock you onto your backside only make you flinch. It doesn't stop being sent flying or being grabbed.

random.desc:
Increases the likelihood fish
will bite when fishing.
random.brief: The fishing gauge fills in 7 steps instead of 10, Sushifish, Burst and Goldenfish Bait catch up to 3 fish instead of 2, and the next fish heads straight for the bait.

random.desc:
Grants a quick recovery when
sent flying by a monster.
random.brief: When a monster sends you flying, you recover quickly instead of a long tumble. Being knocked onto your backside is Felyne Feet's job.

random.desc: Speeds up Palico growth.
random.brief: Your Palicos get x1.5 experience at the end of the quest.

random.desc:
Increases Attack and Defense
at the start of a Quest for
a limited amount of time.
random.brief: +3 Attack and +10 Defense for the first 10 minutes of the quest, counted on the quest timer.

random.desc:
Greatly extends the
invulnerability period
when getting up.
random.brief: After getting up from a knockdown you stay untouchable for 0.6 s instead of the normal 0.2 s.

random.desc:
Extends the invulnerability
period when getting up.
random.brief: After getting up from a knockdown you stay untouchable for 0.4 s instead of the normal 0.2 s.

random.desc:
Increases Bowgun damage, but
also increases Deviation.
random.brief: Bowgun shots (not Wyvern S) and Bow arrows deal x1.05 damage, but deviation goes up one level and arrows scatter more. Steadiness cancels the deviation level for level.

random.desc: Strengthens kicks.
random.brief: Kicks hit 5 times as hard, though a kick is still a weak attack.

random.desc:
Increases damage inflicted
by the Shadowbox gesture.
random.brief: The Shadowbox gesture hits 5 times as hard; it is still very weak, so this is mostly for fun.

random.desc:
Decreases Stamina loss
on walls or icicles. Also
withstands some attacks.
random.brief: Certain evades cost 25% less Stamina, and during some movements hits don't knock you back while you have Health. Includes Felyne Gripper's effect.

random.desc:
Allows you to withstand
some attacks while
on walls or icicles.
random.brief: During some movements, hits don't knock you back as long as you still have Health. Adds nothing alongside Felyne Cliffhanger.

random.desc:
Prevents knockbacks from
attacks while carving.
random.brief: Hits don't knock you out of carving. Same effect as Carving Pro, so it adds nothing with it or Carving Celebrity.

random.desc:
Prevents stumbling when jumping
down from high places.
random.brief: You always land normally from any height instead of stumbling, and can act straight away. Works for Prowlers too.

random.desc:
Grants a temporary Attack
boost when you use the Kick
Back gesture for a while.
random.brief: Hold the Kick Back gesture for 5 seconds to get +15 Attack for 30 seconds. It shares the timed Attack boost of some consumables, so the last one used replaces the other.

random.desc:
Increases Sharpness when you
strike right after an
attack is deflected.
random.brief: After a bounce, your following hits count x1.1 sharper per bounce in a row, so they bounce less and deal x1.1 raw damage. Other actions reset it.

random.desc:
Causes food effects to remain
even after you faint in battle.
random.brief: Keeps your meal's extra Health, Attack and other bonuses after a faint for the rest of the quest. Felyne skills stay active after a faint even without it.

random.desc:
Makes it easier to
stun monsters.
random.brief: Your hits build x1.1 stun, covering melee hits, Bow arrows, phials and some bowgun shots. It is the same bonus as Knockout King, so it does nothing with it.

random.desc:
Increases Ballista, Crag shot
(Crag S), Gunlance ammo, Cannon,
and Demolisher damage.
random.brief: Gunlance shells, Wyvern's Fire and ballista x1.1; Charge Blade phials, Crag S, Cannon S and Wyvern S x1.15. Stacks with Artillery up to each source's limit (x1.3 or x1.4).

random.desc:
Prevents fainting one time
when damage taken exceeds
your remaining Health.
random.brief: Survive one hit that would make you faint, on 1 Health, if you had at least 64 Health. Once per quest; with Guts it is a separate second save.

random.desc:
Guarantees Dung Bombs will be
effective, and ensures their
Combinations will succeed.
random.brief: Dung Bombs and Dung S hit 1.5 times as hard with their dung effect, and the Dung Bomb combination always succeeds (normally 75%).

random.desc:
Halves the effect durations of
Defense Down and Resistance Down,
and speeds Blight recovery.
random.brief: Defense Down lasts 90 s instead of 3 min and Resistance Down 1 min instead of 2, and each roll shakes off much more of a blight.

random.desc:
Prevents damage from
environmental effects.
random.brief: Protects from harmful ground, not hot or cold areas: no damage from the slower-burning hot ground, no Iceblight from freezing ground, no poison from poison ground.

random.desc:
Guarantees a large monster
will appear when the hunting
environment is unstable.
random.brief: On unstable quests the extra monster always appears, at the earliest time the quest allows. It doesn't change which monster comes.

random.desc:
Displays large monsters on the
Map at the start of a Quest
for a limited amount of time.
random.brief: Shows all large monsters on your map for the first 30 seconds of the quest. Useless with Autotracker.

random.desc: Often speeds up sharpening time.
random.brief: Sharpening often takes 1 to 3 whetstone strokes instead of 4: about 3.1 seconds on average instead of 4.3. Adds nothing to Speed Sharpening.

random.desc: Makes it easier to mount monsters.
random.brief: Jumping attacks build mounting x1.125 faster. Stacks with Mounting Master and Airborne up to a x1.4 cap; no help in the struggle once mounted.

random.desc:
Fills gauge faster when attacking a
monster mounted by another player.
random.brief: Your hits on a monster another hunter is riding fill the rider's struggle gauge x1.2 faster. It never helps your own mounts.

random.desc:
Prevents your group from being penal-
ized the first time a member faints.
random.brief: The party's first faint is free: it doesn't count toward the limit, cut reward money or cost Hunter Rank Points. Once per quest; one member having it is enough.

random.desc:
Draws monsters' attention, increasing
the likelihood of being targeted.
random.brief: Monsters pay x1.5 as much attention to you, so you are targeted more. Same boost as Taunt and doesn't stack with it.

random.desc:
Sometimes increases the number
of Reward Items received at
the end of a Quest.
random.brief: 50% chance of one extra item in each of your two main quest-reward lists, rolled separately. Stacks with Good Luck and the other luck skills.

random.desc:
Sometimes increases the number
of times you can carve.
random.brief: 13% chance of one extra carve on each monster you kill. Does nothing with Carving Celebrity, which already guarantees the extra carve.

random.desc:
Causes additional Supply Items
to be delivered immediately.
random.brief: Both of the quest's later supply deliveries arrive right at the start. Only matters on quests with timed supply deliveries.

random.desc:
Increases the amount of zenny
received at the end of a Quest.
random.brief: Quest reward money x1.5 (50%), x1.75 (30%) or x2.0 (20%), on cleared quests only. Shopkeeping is ignored while you have it.

random.desc:
Increases the number of
Hunter Rank Points received
for completing a Quest.
random.brief: x1.5 Hunter Rank Points for the quest's main, subquest and bonus rewards. Faint and failure penalties are not multiplied.

random.desc:
Increases the amount of Wycademy
Points earned at the end of a Quest.
random.brief: Wycademy Points from the quest x1.5 (50%), x1.75 (30%) or x2.0 (20%), including the smaller main reward of a failed quest.

of Reward Items received at
the end of a Quest.
alcohol.brief: One guaranteed extra item in each of your two main quest-reward lists, on top of your normal luck. Replaces Lucky Cat and stacks with the luck skills.

of times you can carve.
alcohol.brief: 13% chance of one extra carve on each monster you kill. Does nothing with Carving Celebrity, which already guarantees the extra carve.

alcohol.desc:
Often increases the number
of times you can carve.
alcohol.brief: 26% chance of one extra carve on each monster you kill. Does nothing with Carving Celebrity, which already guarantees the extra carve.

alcohol.desc:
Causes unfortunate events to
occur at the start of a Quest...
alcohol.brief: You start the quest with 25 health, maximum stamina cut to 25, or both (50% both). With Jinxed Cat too you get both plus 60 seconds of Confusion.

alcohol.desc:
Ensures you always begin in
Hidden Areas during Quests
with random starting points.
alcohol.brief: You always start in the map's hidden area on quests with random starting points. No effect on Verdant Hills and Jungle.

alcohol.desc:
Restores Health to party members
in the area after fainting in battle.
alcohol.brief: When you faint, every teammate in the same area gets 100 Health back. It does nothing for yourself.

alcohol.desc:
Causes mildly unpleasant events
to occur at the start of a Quest...
alcohol.brief: You start with 60 seconds of Confusion, maximum stamina cut to 25, or both (50% both). Health is not touched.
